gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Audiowide draws every stroke with a marker nib, tile-like and futuristic. Its heading letters hold one line weight, while Noto Sans Gurmukhi keeps outward-pointing terminals and low ascenders that suit steady text.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta spaces its letters wide, with tall-bodied small forms in ribbon-like strokes. Oswald packs its rows tightly and speaks with confidence, while Lexend Zetta stays approachable and open.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-kannad: Letters that never seem to pinch shut give Almendra Display its ornate, literary pull, with a pronounced x-height. Noto Sans Kannada, a plain sans, is gentler and more contemporary.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Audiowide sets its futuristic letters like tiles, every stroke cut to a single width. Noto Sans Hanunoo fills most of the line height with lowercase, so it can be sized up a little to feel comfortable.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-cascadia-mono: Oswald knits its rows tightly and speaks with confidence at the top. Cascadia Mono stands letters like pins in a wide board, a compact sans with curves as thick as its stems.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-kayah-: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display keeps its letters from pinching shut and raises a pronounced x-height. And Noto Sans Kayah Li, a plain sans with lifted brush ends, gives that decoration somewhere quiet to rest.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Noto Sans Hebrew has a dominant midsection that swallows the line. Audiowide, with tile-like glyphs and no stroke modulation, gives the heading a futuristic edge while the sans below keeps wide gaps between curve ends and stems.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-kharos: Ornate letters with a pronounced x-height give Almendra Display a literary mood, never pinching shut. Noto Sans Kharoshthi lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through each line.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-hk: Futuristic and tech-minded, Audiowide cuts its curves and stems with no swelling at the joins. And Noto Sans HK takes over for the text, with large lowercase forms and brush ends lifted before curves close.
gen-special-elite-gf-fauna-one: Distressed, typewriter-flavored and a little rebellious. Special Elite fills the line with its big x-height, while Fauna One, a dignified serif with a tall middle band, answers in a literary, shallow-ascender voice.
